title: 2696. Minimum String Length After Removing Substrings

examples.explanation: We can do the following operations: - Remove the substring "ABFCACDB", so s = "FCACDB". - Remove the substring "FCACDB", so s = "FCAB". - Remove the substring "FCAB", so s = "FC". So the resulting length of the string is 2. It can be shown that it is the minimum length that we can obtain.
We cannot do any operations on the string so the length remains the same.
